rows.name: Steakhouse Financial

Claim or restake any yield the vault pays into the same vault once, and keep the receipt. Cost: about $3 of gas. Time: 10 minutes.
Do one qualifying action each week, such as a deposit, a swap, a vote or a claim, and keep gas for it in the wallet. Cost: about $2 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
